items.title: George Masso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: It’s Dick Johnson, Lou Columbo — are you familiar with that name? Dave McKenna, Marshall Wood, Artie Cabral, a drummer from Providence, and myself. It’s a sextet.

ctx.x: I have one that was just released, and I call it “That Old Gang of Mine.” It’s on Arbors. And it’s all players from the southern New England area that I grew up with, with the exception of Marshall Wood, the bassist, but he’s such a good player, he had to be on it. I’ve known Marshall at least ten years. But the other guys I’ve known for about 40 years and I’ve been wanting to do this. It’s Dick Johnson, Lou Columbo — are you familiar with that name? Dave McKenna, Marshall Wood, Artie Cabral, a drummer from…
Wow. That’s a good label. I mean they really are supporting this kind of music, whatever it is.
